items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Some of them now, you catch that Morgan boy that's playing with Cab Callaway.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know. It's tough to think of a college name.
And some of the boys around Chicago, but I mean New York, that's playing saxophone right now. Some of them now, you catch that Morgan boy that's playing with Cab Callaway.
With Al Morgan. Al Morgan played a bass player.
